subject: Systemic C13/C15 Fix Required for STR_1304~1326 (19 strategies)
description:
All 19 Factor DB strategies fail Gate 0 due to C13/C15 violations.
Before ANY new Factor DB strategy, Forge MUST:
1. source('02_Infrastructure/factor_db_connector.R')
2. Use load_month_factors(sig_date) -> returns Z_Score_Aligned (higher=better, pre-aligned)
3. NEVER create NEGATE_LIST or manually flip signs
4. Use compute_rolling_ic_all() for IC data access
5. NEVER use read_parquet() directly on factor_db/ files

Re-implement top 3 most promising concepts with correct connector:
- STR_1325 (Regime Sparse SDF / Kozak ridge) -> interesting theoretical concept
- STR_1324 (ICIR Momentum Rotation) -> implicit regime switching
- STR_1318 (Sign-Flip Contrarian) -> best SR=0.808 in batch

fix_rules.C13: NEVER use NEGATE_LIST. Z_Score_Aligned from load_month_factors() is already direction-corrected.
fix_rules.C15: NEVER use read_parquet() on factor_db/ files. Use load_month_factors() and compute_rolling_ic_all().
